people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: All these were men of war, who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
translations.bsb: All these men of war, arrayed for battle, came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel. And all the rest of the Israelites were of one mind to make David king.
translations.kjv: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
translations.asv: All these being men of war, that could order the battle array, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
